varsikasikranaatti: Felix Varsikasikra reported to S-F12 with a lock of hair in a matchbox sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Felix Varsikasikra is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Felix Varsikasikra taught Severin Sky to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In S-F12, Felix Varsikasikra listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
